items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She was one of Mark Murphy’s first fans.

ctx.x: were they very proactive about exposing you to culture and...

Yes, my mother is... When it comes to the jazz world, she can hear someone come on the radio and she’ll know exactly who it is. She was one of Mark Murphy’s first fans. She’s spectacular that way. But you know, this was a time... I was a very independent kid, and I really knew what I wanted, and they trusted me. They wanted me to have my happiness, so they let me go. Now, looking back, I see...I don’t think I would have allowed my kids to do that. I know I wouldn’t have.
I don’t know exactly what years we’re talking about, but it was a very different time, and the Village was a very different place.
